author: IfeelBlocky
body:
Today, On June 3rd 2015, I was banned by DeciduousRikii at 3:45 EST for "Hacking-Regeneration".
I am appealing this ban because I was obviously not regen hacking since I was battling IN WATER and was using POSEIDON KIT on the Blue Cove Map. The fact that I cant play on my favorite server because I was falsely banned makes me very upset, hence why I am appealing immediately and asking that this ban be appealed and made right since I have no serious infractions of any kind from the past year.
Thank you in advance,
IfB

title: Banned- "RegenHacks" Poseidon Kit on Walls?

replies.author: hpux
replies.body:
Hello,

I have decided to appeal your infraction and give you the benefit of the doubt because you provided a logical explanation towards your ban, and do not have any past infractions for hacking. However, if you are banned again, your chances of being unbanned will decrease to a minimum, if not 0%.

Regards,

Vacuum, Avicus Network Administrator.
